keyFindings.description: Cutover steps 2 and 4 misstate what the removal push does. Under the new daemon (step 4) any removal push voids an approval not yet completed (ApprovalStands needs the head itself -> stuckApprovedOtherCode), clears the tester's planned-red mark (AdvancePullRequestHead/ApplyPush set PlannedRed from the implement App's push -> standingRed sends testing back), and counts a fix attempt on a red head. Under the old daemon (step 2) a removal of another issue's .legion/<OTHER>/ is a code push (old HandoffPath), so 'keeps its verdict and its approval' is not true for such branches. State the effects, or have the import refuse the removal push on testing/reviewing issues and print why.

move() reads every 422 from the ref update as 'the branch moved'. A ruleset or validation 422 is retried three times and reported as 'moved under the removal commit 3 times; run the import again', hiding GitHub's real answer. Tell a moved branch by reading the head again (or by GitHub's not-a-fast-forward message) and report any other 422 with its body.

The PR adds refusals (HANDOFF_RECORD_REQUIRED, HANDOFF_RECORD_NOT_FOUND, HANDOFF_RECORD_MISMATCH, HANDOFF_SESSION_MISMATCH, DISPATCH_READ_FAILED on completion, Dispatch's HANDOFF_FORBIDDEN/HANDOFF_INPUT/CAP_EXCEEDED), makes commit optional and adds handoffId/handoffVersion at the daemon API boundary (contract 41), and removes READY_HEAD_CARRIES_HANDOFFS, but the body has no '## Contract change census' with search commands, every hit's disposition and the rollout line.

The next worker's task names 'Handoff: <word> version <n>' but its command reads the newest record, so any later write to the phase (the import's check-then-write at step 4, or a stray rewrite) makes the next role read a body the daemon never accepted. Put --version <n> in the command the task names.
unreviewedChange walks the files twice and adds a 'path != ""' guard that lets a file GitHub lists with no name pass, where the old loop refused it. One loop, no guard.

phase.FileBacked has no production caller left (its doc 'a handoff file its role writes and commits' is false after the cutover), and api.recordWriters is a second copy of workflow.RoleFor for the four handoff phases, with workflow.handoffWord inverting the pair a third way. One table of word and writer; delete FileBacked and recordWriters' tie test.
